description: This Java class 'Encounter' models a clinical encounter in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It encapsulates details such as encounter time, patient, location, form, type, observations, orders, diagnoses, conditions, providers, allergies, and related methods for managing these entities within the encounter context.

classes.name: Encounter
classes.description: Represents a patient's encounter with a healthcare provider, including details like date, type, location, observations, diagnoses, and associated providers within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Returns all non-voided, non-obsGroup child observations associated with this encounter, including hierarchical levels up to three.

methods.name: addObs
methods.description: Adds an observation to this encounter, propagating encounter attributes to the obs and its group members.

methods.name: getAllObs
methods.description: Returns all observations for this encounter, optionally including voided ones.

methods.name: getAllFlattenedObs
methods.description: Returns a flattened set of all observations in this encounter, including observations within groups.
